newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end lacklustre bourse trade lower.
newsitem.headline: German shares end lacklustre bourse trade lower.

text.p: 1344 GMT - German shares mostly tread water in bourse trade on Friday at lower levels, with sentiment muted by lower, albeit stable, dollar and overnight weakness on Wall Street. Market jitters in advance of options expiry and softer German debt also impact, dealers talk of wholesale selling. Talk of imminent correction.
* DAX-30 index ends at 3,184.09 points, up 11.94 points and off earlier low point of 3,171.05.
* March DAX future at 3,191 points, down 14.
* Puma down as 96 figures below expectations.
* Schering ends higher after Dresdner upgrade.
